_README: Paste your curated entries into the AbilityMap section, then merge this file into BepInEx\config\kdpen.Beelzebub\ability_rules.json (or copy this whole object's AbilityMap block in). Valid Weapons: Magic, Unarmed, Sword, GreatSword, Axe, Mace, DualHammers, Spear, Daggers, Crossbow, Longbow, Pistols, Reaper, Whip, Claws. Valid Forms: Wolf, Bear, Rat, Spider, Toad. Empty Weapons array = universal (any weapon). Empty Forms array = not form-restricted. TransformOnly:true blocks .beelz grant for this ability.

AB_Paladin_MeleeAttack_AbilityGroup.Notes: Physical melee — works with any sword-family weapon

AB_Paladin_ShockWaveSlam_AbilityGroup.Notes: Heavy ground slam — feels right with two-handed weapons

AB_Paladin_Dash_AbilityGroup.Notes: Universal dash — usable in any slot

AB_Bandit_Hunter_Bow_Group.Notes: Generic ranged shot — fits any bow-like weapon

AB_Shapeshift_Wolf_Bite_Bleed_AbilityGro.Notes: Wolf bite — only fires while in Wolf form

AB_Solarus_HolyPillar_AbilityGroup.Notes: Too OP for normal grants — transform-only
